title: `SUM` is no longer casting to Integer with our custom MySQL adapter
body:
In #39039 and then followup PRs the types on calculation got changed.                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                             
We have a custom adapter at GitHub and the client for that adapter follows the MySQL spec - that `SUM` on integers should return a `BigDecimal`. See https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/5.7/en/group-by-functions.html#function_sum for more information on that. 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
We have been unable to reproduce this outside of our application and at the moment our adapter and client are private so we can't share a reproduction script that actually breaks. The one provided here passes, but we've added notes about the behavior in GitHub.                                                     
                                                                                                                                                             
In our case the `BigDecimal` for `sum` calls was converted into `Integer` and now remains a `BigDecimal`. We have found that we can "fix" this by calling `yield` when we're using `sum` in `type_cast_calculated_value`, however that breaks other enum tests and we're not sure of next steps.

It also feels odd that the `type_cast_calculated_value` method only yields in the case of max and min, but the code makes it look like it always yields. With our bug it seems like there are more cases we should yield to ensure we deserialize.
                                                                                                                                                             
Here is the diff that fixes our use case, but breaks enums:                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                             
``` ruby
--- a/activerecord/lib/active_record/relation/calculations.rb
+++ b/activerecord/lib/active_record/relation/calculations.rb
@@ -417,7 +417,7 @@ def type_for(field, &block)
       def type_cast_calculated_value(value, operation)
         case operation
         when "count", "sum"
-          value || 0
+          yield value || 0
         when "average"
           value&.respond_to?(:to_d) ? value.to_d : value
         else # "minimum", "maximum"
```                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             
And here is the script that doesn't fail for MySQL or other adapters, but fails with our adapter.                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                             
```ruby
require "active_record"                                                                                                                                      
require "minitest/autorun"                                                                                                                                   
require "logger"                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: "mysql2", database: "activerecord_unittest")                                                                
ActiveRecord::Base.logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                             
ActiveRecord::Schema.define do                                                                                                                               
  create_table :posts, force: true do |t|                                                                                                                      end                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                             
  create_table :comments, force: true do |t|                                                                                                                 
    t.integer :post_id                                                                                                                                       
    t.integer :stars                                                                                                                                         
  end                                                                                                                                                        
end                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                             
class Post < ActiveRecord::Base                                                                                                                              
  has_many :comments                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                               def sum_comment_stars                                                                                                                                      
    comments.where('1=1').sum(:stars)                                                                                                                        
  end                                                                                                                                                        end                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                             
class Comment < ActiveRecord::Base                                                                                                                           
  belongs_to :post                                                                                                                                           
end                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                             
class BugTest < Minitest::Test                                                                                                                               
  def test_association_stuff                                                                                                                                 
    post = Post.create!                                                                                                                                      
    post.comments << Comment.create!(stars: 20)                                                                                                              
    post.comments << Comment.create!(stars: 300)                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             
    assert_equal 320, post.sum_comment_stars                                                                                                                 
    assert_equal Integer, post.sum_comment_stars.class # This returns BigDecimal in our app.                                                                 
  end                                                                                                                                                        
end                                                                                                                                                          
```
                                                                                                                                                             
This is unfortunately blocking our Rails upgrade and we're not sure how to fix this. @kamipo can you take a look and let us know what you think?

Thanks!
